mapper.sql:
quote_id AS "quoteId", product_name AS "productName", spec AS "spec", product_type AS "productType", storage AS "storage",
(SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = quotes.storage LIMIT 1) AS "storageNm", client_code AS "clientCode", (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = quotes.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", note AS "note", bom_json AS "bomJson", material_cost AS "materialCost", markup_rate AS "markupRate", markup_cost AS "markupCost", loss_rate AS "lossRate", loss_cost AS "lossCost", labor_cost AS "laborCost", packaging_cost AS "packagingCost", logistics_cost AS "logisticsCost", margin AS "margin", other_cost1 AS "otherCost1", other_cost1_note AS "otherCost1Note", other_cost2 AS "otherCost2", other_cost2_note AS "otherCost2Note", other_cost3 AS "otherCost3", other_cost3_note AS "otherCost3Note", other_cost4 AS "otherCost4", other_cost4_note AS "otherCost4Note", current_price AS "currentPrice", total_price AS "totalPrice", status AS "status", confirmed_product_code AS "confirmedProductCode", created_at AS "createdAt", source_kind AS "sourceKind", source_recipe AS "sourceRecipe"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quotes ORDER BY quote_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotes ( product_name, spec, product_type, storage, client_code, bom_json, material_cost, loss_rate, loss_cost, markup_rate, markup_cost, labor_cost, packaging_cost, logistics_cost, margin, other_cost1, other_cost1_note, other_cost2, other_cost2_note, other_cost3, other_cost3_note, other_cost4, other_cost4_note, current_price, total_price, note, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{productName}, #{spec}, #{productType}, #{storage}, #{clientCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bomJson}, #{materialCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lossRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lossCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{markupRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{markupCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{laborCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{packagingCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{logisticsCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{margin,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost1,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost1Note}, #{otherCost2,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost2Note}, #{otherCost3,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost3Note}, #{otherCost4,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost4Note}, #{currentPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{totalPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{note}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE quotes SET product_name = #{productName}, spec = #{spec}, product_type = #{productType}, storage = #{storage}, client_code = #{clientCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, bom_json = #{bomJson}, material_cost = #{materialCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, loss_rate = #{lossRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, loss_cost = #{lossCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, markup_rate = #{markupRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, markup_cost = #{markupCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, labor_cost = #{laborCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, packaging_cost = #{packagingCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, logistics_cost = #{logisticsCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, margin = #{margin,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, other_cost1 = #{otherCost1,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, other_cost1_note = #{otherCost1Note}, other_cost2 = #{otherCost2,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, other_cost2_note = #{otherCost2Note}, other_cost3 = #{otherCost3,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, other_cost3_note = #{otherCost3Note}, other_cost4 = #{otherCost4,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, other_cost4_note = #{otherCost4Note}, current_price = #{currentPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, total_price = #{totalPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, note = #{note} WHERE quote_id = #{quoteId}
